# Update the bucket list item to done
import re
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sn = [c for c in creds if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='ron.harrison@gmail.com', password=sn['password'])
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

note_id = 318
note_resp = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
content = note_resp['content']
old_line = '[ ] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch'
new_line = '[x] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch'
print('old line exists:', old_line in content)
updated_content = content.replace(old_line, new_line)
print('updated differs:', updated_content != content)
# show diff snippet
for line in content.splitlines():
    if 'Learning to cook' in line:
        print('before:', line)
for line in updated_content.splitlines():
    if 'Learning to cook' in line:
        print('after:', line)

resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id, content=updated_content)
print('update response:', resp)
# verify
ver = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
print('verify line:', [ln for ln in ver['content'].splitlines() if 'Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch' in ln])
